items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Even before that, I think about, you know, the Thomas family, Joyce W. Thomas, they came out of Houston. [INTERVIEWEE] The family's still there, I understand.

ctx.x: That was a big thing, that's where your blues was. Yeah. It wasn't in the bands, it was in individuals. You were referring to blues players like, maybe, Muddy Water, which you referred to something, I thought.
Even before that, I think about, you know, the Thomas family, Joyce W. Thomas, they came out of Houston.
